simulator.note: Boots as M3503 rev B with 256 MB DDR3 (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_ali3516_galaxy_starlight_2435_app_starts.py, run_dump_ali3516_galaxy_starlight_2435_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3516A 1.2.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!" and writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA14187DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80002000 / 0x8E002001).  The application prints "hs_config_init", updates the CH455 display, populates userdb(64+64) at 0xF3FF80, and draws its 1280x720 Starlight OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko HD8260+ / Galaxy Combo 220 Starlight 1CA 1CI (System ID 14000A00) firmware v2.4.35 (2017-5-17) on a 16 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3516A / M3503 rev B Full HD DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver with 256 MB DDR3.
Pairs dual-CPU M3503 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200) with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 135 / 134 and a 60-entry 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
